svg.text: Step 1 — Full text tokenised (instruction + response as one sequence)
Step 2 — inputs = padded[:-1] · targets = padded[1:] (shift by 1)
↑ target at pos 5 = token 60 (first response token)
Step 3 — Book default: mask only extra padding tokens in targets with -100
Another sequence in same batch is shorter — padded to match:
Optional (Exercise 7.2) — instruction masking: also mask instruction tokens in targets
Back to the first sequence. With instruction masking applied:

g.text: What the model actually learns at each position
Given input token 10 → predict 20 (instruction → next instruction word)
Given input token 50 → predict 60 (last instruction token → first response token)
Given input token 80 → predict 99 (last response token → EOS, "I'm done")
With instruction masking: only positions 5–8 contribute to the loss
